title: 1991 paper on technology-assisted consciousness circulated in aerospace and CIA

tellings.quote: 1991 I wrote a paper went all through the aerospace industry and CIA which kind of also put me on the radar

plain: In 1991 the UFO activist Steven Greer wrote a paper, on what he connects to technology-assisted consciousness and to contact with extraterrestrials, that he says spread "all through the aerospace industry and CIA". He tells Michels this about himself, and says the paper "kind of also put me on the radar", meaning it brought him to the attention of people in those circles.
